Name: ReservePlan
Author: RedoClouds
Description:
ReservePlan helps you plan stock reserves without moving items. Save quantity targets and minimum quality in up to 10 named profiles per save and player. Each profile supports 100 targets. The overview compares your targets with observed backpack, ordinary player-chest and fridge stock across loaded locations.

[b]Using ReservePlan[/b]
Press F11 to open or close the overview. Use Up/Down or the D-pad to scroll and Escape/B to close. The panel does not pause time. The open key is configurable in config.json.

SMAPI console examples:
reserveplan set (O)378 20 0 — target 20 normal-or-better copper ore
reserveplan profile building — select or create a named profile
reserveplan profiles — list profiles
reserveplan list — print current totals
reserveplan help — show commands

Quality thresholds are 0 normal, 1 silver, 2 gold and 4 iridium. Targets match qualified item IDs across flavors: a wine target includes all wine flavors at that minimum quality. Unknown modded qualities are excluded.

ReservePlan is advisory: it does not lock stacks, intercept machines or stop Automate and other mods from consuming items. Targets are independent goals, not allocations among recipes. Counts cover supported loaded storage, and incomplete scans are marked.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Extract ReservePlan into Mods and keep the included Quicksan.Stardew.Common.dll beside ReservePlan.dll. No other mod is required. Profiles are stored in this mod’s data folder separately from game saves; keep that folder if you want your plans after uninstalling.

If you find bugs or problems, please report them through the Bugs or Posts tab so we can fix them. Feature requests and suggestions are welcome. Include versions and reproduction steps, and remove private information from logs.
